people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
translations.bsb: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
translations.asv: And thou shalt bring the bullock before the tent of meeting: and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock.
